## Description
Briefly describe the change and its motivation or context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] All Pest tests pass locally (`vendor/bin/pest`)
- [ ] Tests covering the new functionality or bug fix have been added
- [ ] Code follows PSR-12 and strict types (`declare(strict_types=1);`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where relevant
